title: Projects Meeting
description: ​Join us for a Projects Meeting to hear what the Pittsburgh Hub will be working on in the months ahead and where you can plug in. Ian Chang will lead the conversation, with space to walk through current priorities, answer questions, and share what is taking shape across upcoming initiatives.

title: Burnout Discussion
description: ​Burnout can creep in quietly, making even simple tasks feel heavier than they should. In this discussion, Andrew Coutinho will open up a practical conversation about what burnout looks like, how it shows up at work and in everyday life, and what can help when you start to feel stretched too thin.
